name: Hornero Countdown
description: Countdown 2.0: compact bar countdown (5/10/25 presets) with a popover, progress, deadline-correct timing across sleep/reload and a completion toast. No sound, no processes, no network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

defaultMinutes.description: Countdown length in minutes used until a preset is chosen.

deadlineEpochMs.description: Saved running deadline in epoch milliseconds (0 when not running). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

totalSeconds.description: Saved countdown length in seconds (0 means the default length). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

remainingSeconds.description: Saved paused time remaining in seconds (0 means a full countdown). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

changelog.notes: Productivity Timers 2.0: compact indicator plus popover with presets and progress, deadline-correct timing persisted across sleep/reload, typed defaultMinutes setting (default 5), completion toast, Theme tokens and Argentine Spanish translation.
Bar countdown with 5/10/25 minute presets, start/pause/reset and a flashing DONE ring at zero.
